_about: Codex smoke suite: one cross-vendor cell against the harness's own distractor server, for proving the codex driver's mechanics live (50-drivers.md). Kept separate from prompts.json so the claude-only smoke stays runnable without an OpenAI key: this suite's preflight refuses to run unless OPENAI_API_KEY is exported (the noweb custom provider authenticates via env_key; the value reaches codex by process env only and appears in no artifact).
_q2: Running this live is part of, not all of, settling Q2 for codex (50-drivers.md, closing paragraph): a healthy run's api-surface.jsonl must show only MCP tools (no web_search), zero web-search events in runner-stdout.txt/runner-stderr.txt, and meta.json pins the codex version. The secrets-file canary needs a suite whose server takes a $secret, which this SUT does not.

smoke-codex._: proves: isolated CODEX_HOME, noweb provider routed through the harness recorder, read-only sandbox with never-approvals plus per-server MCP pre-approval, answer via -o file, reasoning_effort in codex's own vocabulary. Model choice is load-bearing: the tool roster codex sends is MODEL-dependent (measured 2026-09-01 on codex-cli 0.147.0 by wire capture: gpt-5.2 carries a hosted web_search tool that NO config knob removes -- tools.web_search=false, web_search_mode, tools.web_search.mode all left it in the array -- while gpt-5.6-luna's array carries no web tool). A cell on a web-carrying model gets BROKEN by the wire breach check, by design.

prompts.title: count the unfiled notes via a traced call
prompts.prompt: Using the notes_sut server's tools, find out how many unfiled notes there are and reply with just the number.
prompts.grounding: neutral-file-triage@2 defines exactly 12 notes and no state file is configured for the SUT, so a fresh server process always reports 12 unfiled (src/mcp_e2e_harness/crowding.py, _TRIAGE_NOTES).
prompts.pass: Answers 12, and the cell's trace contains a notes_sut list_unfiled_notes call.
prompts.fail: Answers without a traced notes_sut call (the number is discoverable no other way), or answers a number other than 12.
